description: This Java source file defines the class `X509AuthProvider`, which is an authentication provider that verifies X.509 certificates against Hono's Credentials API. The class extends `CredentialsApiAuthProvider`, handles creation of credentials from device info, and performs credential validation to produce a `Device` object.

classes.name: X509AuthProvider
classes.description: An authentication provider that verifies X.509 certificates against Hono's Credentials API. It extends CredentialsApiAuthProvider to create credentials from device info and validate credentials to produce a Device object.

methods.name: X509AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a CredentialsClientFactory, ServiceConfigProperties, and Tracer, ensuring the configuration is non-null.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Creates SubjectDnCredentials from device auth info JSON, extracting tenant id and subject DN, returning null if required fields are missing or invalid.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Validates the provided device credentials, creating and returning a Device object with tenant ID and device ID in a Future.
